title: Star Rating
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Star
learningObjectives: Trace how the slider value from 1 to 5 maps to the number of gold-filled star characters drawn on the canvas
Explain why gold indicates an active star and gray an inactive star, and how this color contrast gives immediate visual feedback
Identify the p5.js createSlider() control and describe how its min, max, default of 3, and step values shape the rating input
Predict how the star spacing and sizing change when the container width is resized by responsive canvas code
Evaluate the accessibility of the rating widget using screen reader descriptions and color contrast guidelines
